notes: Breadboard orientation: the image's upper half (rows j-f) is treated as catalogue bank 'b' and the lower half (rows e-a) as bank 't'; resistors bridge the centre gap from column Nb.f to Nt.e.
Column numbers were estimated from the image: LEDs at columns 10/11, 13/14, 16/17, 19/20, 22/23; blue wires land on row d of columns 10, 13, 16, 19, 22.

LED anode is taken as the left leg (resistor side) and cathode as the right leg, matching the schematic. The five short black wires join each cathode column (row i) to the top negative rail; exact rail hole numbers (tn.12, 15, 18, 21, 24) are approximate, and all rail holes are one strip anyway.
The Uno GND pin next to AREF on the digital header is named GND.1; the catalogue does not say which GND index that is.
Signal pin mapping: 6->LED1, 5->LED2, 4->LED3, 3->LED4, 2->LED5, as in the schematic. The Uno is powered and read over USB for serial input; the USB cable is not drawn and is omitted.
